<Picture 1> is the authoritative spatial map of the world, not a visual-style reference. Treat it as a top-down geometric specification of a southern Chinese canal old town in Jiangnan style: white plastered walls, black clay-tile roofs, grey stone-slab streets, wooden two-storey shophouses with hanging red lanterns and fabric signboards, a gentle stone arch bridge over a green canal, moored wooden boats, bright summer daylight. Do not imitate the appearance of the map; infer plausible 3D terrain and architecture.

FIRST-PERSON BICYCLE CAMERA, non-negotiable: shot from a camera mounted on the bicycle's handlebar at exactly 1.6 meters above the ground, looking straight ahead horizontally. The handlebar grips and both of the rider's hands holding them are ALWAYS VISIBLE at the bottom edge of the frame, in every frame. The ground surface fills the lower half of the frame; houses and shopfronts pass at eye level; the horizon stays near the middle. The camera NEVER rises above 1.6 m. Absolutely NO aerial view, NO drone shot, NO bird's-eye view, NO top-down view.

ONE CONTINUOUS RIDE, no stopping anywhere (total 10.1 seconds, 24 fps):
- 0.0s-4.0s: ride straight ahead along a grey stone-slab side street at steady cycling speed; white plaster walls and black-tile roofs of houses glide past on BOTH sides at eye level, fabric shop awnings swaying.
- 4.0s-7.5s: ahead the street meets a canal and rises onto a gentle stone arch bridge; WITHOUT slowing down, ride up the smooth bridge ramp — the surface visibly curves upward, carved stone balustrades rise along both sides, green canal water with moored boats opens up BELOW on both sides.
- 7.5s-10.1s: cresting the arch mid-bridge, still rolling at cruise speed; canal water visible on BOTH sides through the balustrades, the old-town main street with red lanterns visible beyond the far slope ahead. The clip CUTS at the crest while still moving at full speed — do NOT slow down, do NOT cut inside the clip.
The rolling bridge ramp climbed WHILE MOVING is the single most important goal: at 10.1s the camera is at the bridge crest mid-canal, still in motion.
